task: ae.swim SWIM membership/failure detector with seeded simulation and invariant checker
reasoning_summary: Modelled each member as a pure state machine (tick/receive return messages) so protocol timing can be tested by hand and then by a deterministic simulator with latency 1, seeded loss, crashes and blocked links. Safety invariants (DEAD absorbing, incarnations monotonic and never ahead of the subject) run after every tick. The first run failed because suspicion timeout (24 ticks) was shorter than gossip spread time and a 20-tick partition outlasted the isolated node's own suspicions; fixing the test config (64 ticks) rather than the code made all 49 tests pass.
